**Designing Animated Anteater**

I'm focusing on crafting a charming animated SVG. My current thoughts revolve around the specifics of the `viewBox` and ensuring a clean, well-executed design for the anteater on its unicycle, juggling bottles.

**Refining Unicycle Mechanics**

I'm refining the unicycle's structure. My focus is on animating the wheel spokes with a continuous rotation and ensuring the pedals and crank arms move in sync with the anteater's pedaling action. The anteater will face right.

**Adding Motion to Anteater**

I'm detailing the anteater's animation, from its bushy tail swaying for balance to its legs pedaling the unicycle. I'm also planning the head's movement, including a cute blinking eye and a flicking tongue, as it juggles three colorful bottles.

**Animating Juggling Pattern**

I'm focusing on the 3-ball cascade pattern now. My current thoughts are on creating reusable bottle elements, defining their parabolic paths with synchronized rotation, and carefully calculating the staggered start times for a continuous juggle. I'm also refining the juggling area based on the anteater's pose.

**Refining Juggling Trajectories**

I'm refining the bottle trajectories for the 3-ball cascade. I'm adjusting the cubic Bezier curves to ensure symmetry around the anteater's center and detailing the scoop under for a more natural feel. I'm also finalizing the landing and scoop points for each hand.

- **Anteater**: Giant anteater markings (black-and-white shoulder stripe, bushy swaying tail, curved snout with an occasional tongue flick) bobbing gently for balance while pedaling and tossing with both arms.

- **Juggling bottles**: Three spinning glass bottles (emerald, ruby, and amber) following a staggered figure-8 cascade path (`<animateMotion>`).

tools.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.
